headword: {重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}
gloss: heavy spender; big spender; whale (gaming slang)

definitions.explanation: In free-to-play mobile games, players who spend large amounts of money on in-game purchases. From {重|じゅう} (heavy) + {課金|かきん} (in-app charges) + {勢|ぜい} (faction).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}だ。
{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Heavy spenders get powerful characters right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無課金|むかきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}てる→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白|おもしろ}さだ。
examples.english: Being able to beat heavy spenders even without paying is what makes this game fun.

notes:
Made of {重|じゅう} (heavy) + ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧ (in-app payment) + ⟦{勢|ぜい}→〜勢：30490_zei⟧ (group). Refers to players who pour large sums into a free-to-play game's microtransactions — the equivalent English gaming term is "whale."

REGISTER: Casual slang, used in mobile-gaming communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a heavy spender

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無課金|むかきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧: playing without paying — spends no money at all
- ⟦{微課金|びかきん}→微課金：29819_bikakin⟧: light spender — pays only small amounts
